mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q01.stem: Anode material and dissolution differ by plating method.
reasons: True is correct. Soluble and insoluble anodes differ in material and reaction.
False is inappropriate. Soluble and insoluble anodes differ in material and reaction.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q02.stem: Dry processes still require checks of vacuum, heat, gas and electrical hazards.
reasons: True is correct. The method can involve vacuum, heat and gases.
False is inappropriate. The method can involve vacuum, heat and gases.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q03.stem: Every charge passed in every bath is used for the target metal deposit.
reasons: True is incorrect. Some charge is used by side reactions such as hydrogen generation.
False is correct. Some charge is used by side reactions such as hydrogen generation.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q04.stem: Report equipment vibration abnormalities even without visible product scratches.
reasons: True is correct. Appearance inspection and equipment-abnormality checks are separate controls.
False is inappropriate. Appearance inspection and equipment-abnormality checks are separate controls.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q05.stem: Vivid color removes the need to consider drying or thermal effects.
reasons: True is incorrect. Dyes and substrate thermal expansion are also temperature-sensitive.
False is correct. Dyes and substrate thermal expansion are also temperature-sensitive.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q06.stem: In ordinary electroplating, metal ions receive electrons at the cathode.
reasons: True is correct. Metal-ion reduction by electron gain occurs at the cathode.
False is inappropriate. Metal-ion reduction by electron gain occurs at the cathode.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q07.stem: A jig can affect both holding and electrical supply.
reasons: True is correct. A jig serving as a contact also affects quality through current supply.
False is inappropriate. A jig serving as a contact also affects quality through current supply.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q08.stem: Electroplating workpiece polarity can be directly transferred to anodizing.
reasons: True is incorrect. An anodizing workpiece has a different role from ordinary electroplating.
False is correct. An anodizing workpiece has a different role from ordinary electroplating.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q09.stem: Investigate surrounding effects even after a leak dries.
reasons: True is correct. Drying does not prove surrounding or underground effects disappeared.
False is inappropriate. Drying does not prove surrounding or underground effects disappeared.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q10.stem: Anodizing always deposits another silver-colored metal on top.
reasons: True is incorrect. Anodizing oxidizes the substrate surface to form an oxide film; it does not deposit another metal on top.
False is correct. Anodizing oxidizes the substrate surface to form an oxide film; it does not deposit another metal on top.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q11.stem: After installing a measure, effectiveness checks are permanently unnecessary.
reasons: True is incorrect. Installation is implementation, not a permanent guarantee of effectiveness.
False is correct. Installation is implementation, not a permanent guarantee of effectiveness.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q12.stem: Watch for particle carryover from rough-polishing tools into finishing.
reasons: True is correct. Residual coarse particles can create new finishing scratches.
False is inappropriate. Residual coarse particles can create new finishing scratches.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q13.stem: Degreasing and desmutting are not identical processes with different names.
reasons: True is correct. Degreasing removes oil; desmutting deals with other surface impurities.
False is inappropriate. Degreasing removes oil; desmutting deals with other surface impurities.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q14.stem: A titration color change permits concentration calculation without volume records.
reasons: True is incorrect. Color change alone cannot establish the amount of substance used.
False is correct. Color change alone cannot establish the amount of substance used.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q15.stem: Lifted tank lining is an abnormality that should be reported.
reasons: True is correct. Lifting can lead to protective-lining degradation or leaks.
False is inappropriate. Lifting can lead to protective-lining degradation or leaks.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q16.stem: Because precipitation is used in analysis, it is always acceptable in production baths.
reasons: True is incorrect. Analytical use and a production-bath abnormality have different purposes.
False is correct. Analytical use and a production-bath abnormality have different purposes.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q17.stem: Stopped indication and permission for safe entry require separate checks.
reasons: True is correct. Restart and residual energy require controls.
False is inappropriate. Restart and residual energy require controls.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q18.stem: Reading a principles explanation authorizes hot-bath operation.
reasons: True is incorrect. Operation requires equipment-specific training, procedures and authority.
False is correct. Operation requires equipment-specific training, procedures and authority.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q19.stem: Copper corrosion resistance also depends on environment and surface condition.
reasons: True is correct. Chemicals and sulfides can affect copper too.
False is inappropriate. Chemicals and sulfides can affect copper too.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q20.stem: A correct supply display makes dirty contacts irrelevant.
reasons: True is incorrect. The supply display alone does not guarantee local contact.
False is correct. The supply display alone does not guarantee local contact.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q21.stem: Resolve unexplained cloudiness by transferring only clear supernatant without authorization.
reasons: True is incorrect. Moving unconfirmed liquid carries the abnormality into the next process.
False is correct. Moving unconfirmed liquid carries the abnormality into the next process.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q22.stem: Distinguish control limits from product specification limits.
reasons: True is correct. Monitoring process variation and specifying product values address different targets.
False is inappropriate. Monitoring process variation and specifying product values address different targets.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q23.stem: Changing inspection lighting until defects disappear proves improvement.
reasons: True is incorrect. Changing observation conditions to hide defects is not improvement evidence.
False is correct. Changing observation conditions to hide defects is not improvement evidence.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q24.stem: ISO certification automatically passes every property of each product.
reasons: True is incorrect. Organizational certification differs from individual product test results.
False is correct. Organizational certification differs from individual product test results.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q25.stem: Zinc's sacrificial protection differs from nickel and other barrier effects.
reasons: True is correct. Zinc corrodes to protect; a barrier impedes entry.
False is inappropriate. Zinc corrodes to protect; a barrier impedes entry.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q26.stem: Some nonwoven buffs contain abrasive particles.
reasons: True is correct. Particles provide the abrasive action in some products.
False is inappropriate. Particles provide the abrasive action in some products.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q27.stem: Try unconfirmed operations yourself when the instructor leaves.
reasons: True is incorrect. Do not start unconfirmed operations; ask first.
False is correct. Do not start unconfirmed operations; ask first.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q28.stem: Treatment area always means only one face's projected area.
reasons: True is incorrect. Treatment area need not be only a one-sided projection.
False is correct. Treatment area need not be only a one-sided projection.

mfg1-surface-mock-06-theory-q29.stem: Identical chemical pictograms do not necessarily require identical protective-equipment materials.
reasons: True is correct. Protection depends on product, concentration and work conditions.
False is inappropriate. Protection depends on product, concentration and work conditions.
True is incorrect. Gaining electrons is reduction.
False is correct. Gaining electrons is reduction.
